notes.title: Coming Soon: A Major Update for Xi-Portal!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45016314/452f0783e2837ec0405cd1269eb3ca2138db0f9d.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Something’s Changing… A Major Update Is Coming Soon[/b][/h3][p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]We wanted to let you know that we’re working on a [b]major update[/b] for [i]Xi-Portal[/i] (Version 2.0)— and it’s going to shift the entire tone of the game.[/p][p]This isn’t just a small patch or some bug fixes.
We’re taking [i]Xi-Portal[/i] in a deeper, darker direction — toward full [b]psychological horror[/b].[/p][p]We’ve been using tools like [b]ChatGPT[/b] to help us brainstorm, improve writing, and fine-tune the overall experience. It’s been a great way to push the story especially writing,  but every word and decision is still guided by our vision.[/p][h3][b]What to Expect:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]A world that feels more… unstable.[/p][/*][*][p]Characters that act differently depending on what you’ve seen — or missed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New secrets[/b] hidden beneath the surface.[/p][/*][*][p]Puzzles that [b]actually challenge your mind[/b] — nothing too random, but you’ll have to think carefully.[/p][/*][/list][p]The update will also finally allow players to [b]complete the current story arc[/b], but it won’t be easy. You’ll need to explore, pay attention, and maybe even question the game itself.[/p][h3][b]Your Feedback Means Everything[/b][/h3][p]We’re building this update [i]with[/i] the community. If you've played the current version, we’d love to hear:[/p][list][*][p]What confused you?[/p][/*][*][p]What kept you hooked?[/p][/*][*][p]What didn’t quite work?[/p][/*][/list][p]Your feedback helps us make Xi-Portal more immersive, mysterious, and worth your time.[/p][p]Thanks for supporting the project. If you haven’t played yet, now’s a great time to jump in and experience the strange world we’re crafting — just be ready for it to change soon...[/p][p]To contect me:

[b]X:[/b] [/p][p][url="https://x.com/KakaMigu"]https://x.com/KakaMigu[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]Facebook:[/b] [/p][p][url="https://www.facebook.com/KakaMiguu"]https://www.facebook.com/KakaMiguu[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]Instegram:[/b] @kaka.migu[/p][p][b]E-mail:[/b][/p][p] [url="https://KakaMigu@gmail.com"]KakaMigu@gmail.com[/url][/p][p][/p]
